draft_config.name: five-phrases-nana
draft_config.hook: my nana only speaks gheg. these 5 phrases are the only ones that matter

phrase_slides.text: 1. “Si je?” — not just how are you, but i see you
phrase_slides.note: the greeting that opens every door

phrase_slides.text: 2. “Sa mirë qe ke ardhur” — she has been waiting all week
phrase_slides.note: translate gives you “Sa mall qe kam për ty”. wrong language

phrase_slides.text: 3. “Më mori malli për ty” — sayla. it speaks gheg. started free.
phrase_slides.note: not a feature, just the thing that let her say it back

phrase_slides.text: 4. “A ke ngrënë?” — she means i love you
5. “Të dua shumë” — the one you never want to translate
phrase_slides.note: say it back. out loud. today

concepts.caption: 5 phrases in gheg that mean more than any app taught me #albanian #gheg #nana #sayla
